 th Order No. 04/Dated: 15 July, 2024  Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Bagbera P.S. Case No. 27 of 2024,
registered for the offence under Sections 313, 376, 504 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Jamshedpur.
3. As per FIR, petitioner came in contact with the prosecutrix in the year 2020 for the purpose of providing job.
In February, 2023, petitioner forcibly established physical relation with the prosecutrix.
In meantime, prosecutrix got pregnant and her pregnancy was aborted by the accused.

In presence of police officer at Bagbera, the petitioner agreed to marry with her and thereafter,
marriage was performed, but after marriage, he started giving threatening to kill her.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all as alleged in this case.
There is no medical report to suggest any miscarriage of the informant.
Petitioner is daily wage labour and having no criminal antecedent.
Petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 24.03.2024.

Petitioner undertakes to cooperate in the trial of the case by remaining physically present as and when required and shall not indulge in any manner in tampering with the prosecution evidences or influencing the witnesses of prosecution.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of bail.

On the other hand, learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

6. Regard being had to the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation coupled with the materials available against the petitioner, I am inclined to release the petitioner on regular bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner named above is directed to be released on bail on furnishing of bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court of Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Jamshedpur in connection with Bagbera P.S. Case No. 27 of 2024 subject to the conditions:-
(1) Petitioner shall remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial of this case unless prevented from sufficient cause to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court.
(2) Petitioner shall not indulge in any or other similar offence till the conclusion of the trial.
(3) Petitioner shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidences or influencing the prosecution witnesses.
In case of violation of the aforesaid conditions, the bail of the petitioner shall be cancelled and shall be taken into custody by the learned Trial Court itself.
